verdict: Leads surged and cost per lead hit a new low — intake must now convert them.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 87 leads at a cost per lead of $20.83 — a 34% improvement in efficiency as daily spend scaled to roughly $80. The last 7 days alone saw a 135% jump in leads week-over-week, confirming the campaign is delivering. However, none of those leads have moved into active pipeline, which points to a gap in how incoming contacts are being followed up on, not an ads problem. Automating the contact and follow-up process is the immediate priority so leads stop stalling after they arrive. Once intake is running, the next period's focus shifts to retargeting and scaling decisions based on cost per case.

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but none are progressing to active cases — a contact and follow-up gap is letting volume go to waste.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and call access are being stood up now so that every incoming lead is reached within minutes of arriving.
